user.title: Pick a controller
user.description: Likely controllers (named ChargePro, or advertising the FFE0 service) are marked ★ and listed first. Setup reads the controller's device info to confirm it. Close the ChargePro app first: the controller accepts one connection at a time and stops advertising while connected.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up {name}? The controller is contacted to confirm it is a ChargePro MPPT. Close the ChargePro app first: the controller accepts one connection at a time.

manual.title: Enter the controller's address
manual.description: Use the Bluetooth address shown by your adapter or ESPHome proxy, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

data_description.force_single_layout: Only for testing: use the single-battery register layout even if the controller reports the dual-battery layout.

error.device_not_found: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy is hearing this device right now. Check it's in range of an active proxy, and that the ChargePro app is fully closed: the controller stops advertising while a phone is connected.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Move the controller closer to an adapter and make sure the ChargePro app is closed.
error.not_chargepro: The device connected but did not answer like a ChargePro controller.
error.unsupported_model: This controller reports the dual-battery layout, which is not supported yet. To test anyway, add it manually with 'Force single-battery layout'.
error.not_connectable: Home Assistant hears this device only through a passive scanner, so it can't connect. Use a Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome proxy with `bluetooth_proxy: active: true`, within range of the controller.

abort.not_chargepro: This device did not answer like a ChargePro controller.

read_registers.name: Read registers
read_registers.description: Read holding registers from the controller (Modbus function 0x03, read-only) and return them. For checking the protocol on real hardware.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The BougeRV MPPT config entry to read from.

address.name: Start register
address.description: First register, as a decimal number (0x0101 = 257).
